metadata.name: SearchInventory
metadata.description: Use this API  to search inventory using parameters like Inventory Status, Order ID, Product ID etc.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: OrderID
request_fields.description: Order number for an inventory. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Client Id Valid Values: 1422245 Format:XXXXX Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: InventoryStatus
request_fields.description: Status of the inventory Valid values : 1= Approval Pending 2 = Approved 3 = Cards Created 4 = Inventory Dispatch 5 = Received 6 = Inventory Received with return 7 = Lost in Transit 8 = Damaged in Transit 9 = Transfer Received 10 = Transfer Received with return 11 = Transfer - In Transit 12 = Transfer - Lost in Transit 13 = Transfer - Damaged in Transit 14 = Error 15 = Rejected Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PlasticCode
request_fields.description: Plastic Code Valid values:0-9 Example: 32 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: BranchCode
request_fields.description: Code assigned to branch from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:C1006 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: OrderRequestDate
request_fields.description: Date of requesting order Format:mm/dd/yyyy Example:09/26/2020 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CreateDate
request_fields.description: Date of order creation Format:mm/dd/yyyy Example:09/26/2020 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: NumberOfCard
request_fields.description: Total number of cards. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 17 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Allowable Values: 16

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: OrderId
children.description: Order number for an inventory. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478

children.name: RequestedOn
children.description: Request date time of activity Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss:msi Example: 09/12/2016 15:51:19:000

children.name: NumberOfCard
children.description: Total number of cards. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 17

children.name: InventoryStatus
children.description: Status of the inventory Valid values : 1= Approval Pending 2 = Approved 3 = Cards Created 4 = Inventory Dispatch 5 = Received 6 = Inventory Received with return 7 = Lost in Transit 8 = Damaged in Transit 9 = Transfer Received 10 = Transfer Received with return 11 = Transfer - In Transit 12 = Transfer - Lost in Transit 13 = Transfer - Damaged in Transit 14 = Error 15 = Rejected

children.name: RequestedBy
children.description: User id of the user who requested the inventory. Example : abc.cc.admin

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Name of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example: Cash card

children.name: MultiplePlastic
children.description: multiple plastics for the same card or not. Valid Values: Yes,No

children.name: BranchStoreName
children.description: Store Name of the branch Valid values  : A-Z Example - head office
